items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: And he lent me notes. And he showed me the notes of bass horn.

ctx.x: That was the baritone tumor. I didn't have the bass. And I had a fella. He was very nice to me. He's dead now. And he lent me notes. And he showed me the notes of bass horn. And the cliffs of bass horn and the bass violin. And the same. No different whatsoever. It's nothing but some difference. It's in trombone. A little bit off the cliffs of bass violin.
